\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{خرچ} \ur{کرنا} (kharch karnā)}{خرچ کرنا (kharch karnā)}]{\ur{خرچ} \ur{کرنا} (kharch karnā) — to spend}

\label{lesson:UR-C181-kharch-karna}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for to mix; to introduce, then the Urdu for to join.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{خرچ} \ur{کرنا}}
\textbf{\ur{خرچ} \ur{کرنا}} — \emph{kharch karnā} — \textquotedblleft{}to spend\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{خرچ} \ur{کرنا}} (\emph{kharch karnā}) joins \emph{kharch}, \textquotedblleft{}spending\textquotedblright{}, and \emph{karnā}, \textquotedblleft{}to do\textquotedblright{}. \emph{kharch} is Arabic \emph{kharj}, \textquotedblleft{}a going out; expenditure\textquotedblright{}, which reached Urdu through Persian (Lane, root \emph{kh-r-j}); \emph{karnā} comes from Sanskrit \emph{karoti}, \textquotedblleft{}does\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 2814).
\end{cousinweb}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\ur{چکانا} (chukānā)}{چکانا (chukānā)}]{\ur{چکانا} (chukānā) — to pay off, to settle (a bill)}

\label{lesson:UR-C181-chukana}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Urdu for to join, then the Urdu for to spend.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ur{چکانا}}
\textbf{\ur{چکانا}} — \emph{chukānā} — \textquotedblleft{}to pay off, to settle (a bill)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ur{چکانا}} (\emph{chukānā}) is a tadbhava, a word inherited and reshaped by sound change. It comes from \emph{*cukk}, \textquotedblleft{}fall short of, stop\textquotedblright{}, a form CDIAL reconstructs from its descendants (CDIAL 4848). It is the causing form of \emph{chuknā}, \textquotedblleft{}to be finished\textquotedblright{}. CDIAL takes \emph{*cukk} from Prakrit \emph{cukka}, \textquotedblleft{}fallen, mistaken\textquotedblright{}, which replaced Sanskrit \emph{cyuta}, \textquotedblleft{}fallen\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

One more word for this chapter.
\end{grammarlens}
